short: At Jolly Druid, I offer private, remote Spirit Healing sessions. I'm Rowan, a Druid, and I work with plant spirits and guide their soothing energy to you, to calm your mind and replenish your spirit while you rest comfortably at home.
training: I've spent more than 20 years exploring, studying, and practicing spirituality. For the past nine years, my work in spiritual care has centered on the relationships I've developed with plant spirits, a connection that grew naturally from my study and practice of herbalism and Druidry.
long:
Hi, I'm Rowan, a Druid and the person behind Jolly Druid. I offer private, remote Spirit Healing devoted to helping you feel more at ease, clear your mind, and recharge your spirit.

I work with plant spirits and guide their soothing energy to you, to calm your mind and replenish your spirit.

During your session, you rest comfortably at home while I devote my attention and spiritual work entirely to you. There's no video call to attend, no exercises to follow, and nothing you need to do except relax.

Each session is 30 minutes and costs $50. An optional brief phone or text introduction is available beforehand, and you'll receive a personalized written reflection within 24 hours afterward.

My practice is rooted in my lifelong connection with nature, my Druidic spirituality, and a sincere desire to offer others gentle, restorative spiritual care.
size: I am building towards 10 clients per day, this is a very manageable number and one that allows me to give each client the spiritual care they deserve. I would be happy to do this 6-7 days a week as the work fills me up instead of draining me.
